verdict.line: You lose extended trades before level 6 while Renekton's Fury is topped up, but you scale ahead once Stridebreaker and Black Cleaver complete.

brief.thesis: Renekton's Fury bar is the whole matchup: every auto and ability he lands pushes him toward 50 Fury, where Cull the Meek heals harder and Ruthless Predator becomes a three-hit, 1.5s stun that deletes a bad trade. Sett's own resource, Grit, only builds when he is being hit, not when he hits, so Sett cannot out-scale Renekton's Fury spike through auto-trading alone and has to win the lane by baiting cooldowns instead of matching him blow for blow.

theirWindow.when: Renekton is above 50 Fury with W or Q up
theirWindow.what: Do not extend. At 50+ Fury his Q (Cull the Meek) heals for more and his W (Ruthless Predator) upgrades to a three-slash, 1.5s stun that shreds your shields first — a bad trade here can cost half your HP bar before you get a hit back.

yourWindow.when: his E (Slice and Dice) is down or Fury is under 50
yourWindow.what: This is your trade window. Sit at minion range so a whiffed Slice and Dice puts his 16-10s dash on cooldown, then walk in with Q (Knuckle Down)'s move speed, land your two bonus-damage attacks, and use E (Facebreaker) through a minion to guarantee the stun rather than the one-sided slow.

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards staying in extended fights, which is exactly what you need to out-sustain a Fury-stacked Renekton once your items come online rather than losing to his first burst window.

summoners.why: The dominant pick at 90.4% and best win rate (45.3%) — since Renekton holds the solo-kill edge in this matchup, Ignite gives you the extra kill pressure needed to punish his cooldown windows instead of just surviving them.

playing.title: Track Fury before trading
playing.detail: Watch Renekton's Fury bar climb toward 50 — below that threshold his Q and W are weaker and safe to trade into, above it his W becomes a three-slash, 1.5s stun that can end the trade before it starts.

playing.title: Bait his E dash
playing.detail: Slice and Dice is a 450-range dash on a 16-10s cooldown depending on rank. Play at minion range so a whiffed dash puts it on full cooldown, then punish with Q's move speed and bonus damage.

playing.title: Save W for his all-in
playing.detail: Haymaker stores every hit you take as Grit. Hold the shield and punch for the moment he commits his empowered W or E combo, turning his burst window into your true-damage counter.

playing.title: Land E through a minion
playing.detail: Facebreaker only stuns if Renekton is caught between you and something else; if he's alone on your side it just slows him, so position through a minion to guarantee the stun rather than the slow.

playing.title: Ult his overextensions
playing.detail: The Show Stopper has 400 range and a long cooldown (120s down to 80s), so save it for moments he pushes past minions for a Cull the Meek sustain-heal — dragging him away denies that healing entirely.

playing.title: Trade after his stun, not into it
playing.detail: Ruthless Predator stuns for 0.75s (1.5s empowered) with almost no windup, so initiate only once it's used or clearly on cooldown, then close with Q's speed boost for the free autos.

playing.title: Push farm over forced kills
playing.detail: Renekton holds the solo-kill edge in this matchup, so prioritize denying plates and CS over forcing all-ins until Stridebreaker and Black Cleaver complete and your sustained fighting takes over.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, and all win-rate/sample-size numbers are measured from real games on the current patch via OP.GG; the ability breakdowns, timing windows, and tactical reading are our own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Keep an eye out on Renekton’s Fury before fighting him. Use [W] when he tries using his reinforced skill to gain the upper hand in combat.
